Thanks, Aarav! I found your account and the order #W3361211 that contains your Luggage Set. I also see that this order is currently pending.

I have to let you know, though, that I'm unable to swap the Luggage Set for a coat. Modifications and exchanges only allow swapping an item for another item of the same product type. Since a coat is a different product type, I wouldn't be able to make that change.

What I *can* do is help you modify the Luggage Set to a different variation of the same type (for example, a different piece count, color, or material), if any of those options interest you. Alternatively, if you'd prefer, I could help you cancel the luggage item from the order.

Would you like to explore any of these options?
